title: 14-BCV-010 - Oil and gas processing facilities
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014; the STANDATA also references Alberta Fire Code 2014 conditions
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA applies to low-human-occupancy oil/gas processing buildings outside urban areas, housing listed processing equipment; it excludes residential, office and warehouse buildings.

Group F2 classification requires a building no larger than 150 m², a registered Alberta engineering professional’s risk assessment covering specified ventilation, detection, emergency shutdown, fire detection/depressurization and remote fire-fighting water considerations, plus CAPP-guideline training/procedures and other listed measures.

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
